## Autonomy rules

- Never consider a task complete until ALL checklist items in the relevant markdown file are marked `[x]`.
- After completing a step, immediately read the task file again and proceed to the next unchecked item.
- Do not ask for confirmation between steps unless you encounter an ambiguous destructive action.
- Treat `TODO.md`, `TASKS.md`, or any file matching `docs/tasks/*.md` as your task queue.
- A session is done ONLY when all `[ ]` items are `[x]` or you hit a blocker you cannot resolve alone.
